title: Signal and Static Anew
author: W. M. Dunmore
blurb: Kestrel Oyelaran, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, has spent three years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the jump window closes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
